'''Greemon''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="SWI 135">{{InsiderCite|135|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Ewoks: Warriors of Endor!}}</ref> who was present when the captured [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] were presented to the tribe in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Yub Yub">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref>
